title: Head & Neck Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for head and neck cancer. Captures clinical setting (locoregional vs recurrent/metastatic) and, for recurrent/metastatic disease, PD-L1 CPS status, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference. Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Head and Neck Cancers; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Head and Neck Cancers. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.name: Clinical setting
nodes.title: Clinical setting
nodes.description: Locoregionally advanced disease (stage III-IVB) is typically treated with definitive or adjuvant concurrent chemoradiation; recurrent or metastatic disease is treated with systemic therapy selected by PD-L1 status.

nodes.name: PD-L1 CPS status
nodes.title: PD-L1 CPS (recurrent/metastatic)
nodes.description: PD-L1 Combined Positive Score (CPS) determines eligibility for immunotherapy-based regimens in recurrent/metastatic head and neck cancer; CPS below threshold is directed to chemotherapy/cetuximab-based regimens.

nodes.name: Locoregional treatment
nodes.title: Locoregional: concurrent chemoradiation
nodes.description: Locoregionally advanced head and neck cancer - concurrent chemoradiation is the systemic-radiation backbone for definitive or adjuvant treatment. Physician selects.

nodes.name: PD-L1 CPS-positive recurrent/metastatic treatment
nodes.title: Recurrent/metastatic, PD-L1 CPS>=1: immunotherapy options
nodes.description: Recurrent/metastatic head and neck cancer with PD-L1 CPS >= 1 - immune checkpoint inhibitor-based regimens are systemic options. Physician selects.
nodes.path: Head & Neck / Treatment / Recurrent-metastatic / PD-L1 positive

nodes.name: PD-L1 CPS-negative recurrent/metastatic treatment
nodes.title: Recurrent/metastatic, CPS<1: chemotherapy/cetuximab
nodes.description: Recurrent/metastatic head and neck cancer with PD-L1 CPS < 1 - chemotherapy and cetuximab-based regimens are systemic options. Physician selects.
nodes.path: Head & Neck / Treatment / Recurrent-metastatic / PD-L1 negative
